problems: No earlier ia-01-x report or notes existed, so this was a fresh run; the owned table was empty. 15 dossiers written, 6-10 was the aim.

white-huns (ia-01-c) draws the Indian lands (Punjab, Sindh, Kashmir, Gujarat) that the Alchon page now assigns to a separate Alchon entity; alchon-huns draws them 460-541, so the two overlap until white-huns is corrected.
khazaria (ia-01-d) keeps the Don-Dnieper steppe and the north Caucasus piedmont in its shape to 964, which overlaps pechenegs (889-969 contest bridge at confidence 1) and alania (880-964).

turgesh (ia-01-e) and second-turkic-khaganate double-draw Mongolia 692-749 in Cliopatria's Turgesh rows until the turgesh correction is applied; second-turkic keyframe 692 points at the Turgesh 692 shape.
Cliopatria's Mongol Empire starts in 1206, leaving 1203-1206 (kerait), 1204-1206 (naiman) and 1200-1206 (merkit) without a successor shape.
No Wikipedia infobox gives an area for any of the 15 states, so no area ratio was possible.
pechenegs opened 7 pages, over the 2-5 page guide; merkit and yueban opened 1 page each, under it.
Alchon/Nezak identity is unsettled on the pages; the Nezak Huns are folded into alchon-huns and have no dossier of their own.
kingdom-of-gaochang is already used as a counterpart slug by the rouran dossier; tokhara-yabghus is already used by western-gokturks; both now have a file.
Tool failures: none (no page failed to load). The Kausambi place name is missing from the gazetteer and was given as a 100 km lon/lat radius.
